```python
import psutil
import time
import subprocess
import os

def check_battery_health():
    """Battery percentage aur health check karta hai."""
    battery = psutil.sensors_battery()
    if battery:
        print("\n🔋 Battery Status:")
        print(f"   - Percentage: {battery.percent}%")
        print(f"   - Plugged: {'Yes' if battery.power_plugged else 'No'}")
        print(f"   - Time Left: {battery.secsleft // 3600} hours")
        if hasattr(battery, 'power_now') and hasattr(battery, 'energy_full'):
            print(f"   - Current Draw: {battery.power_now / 1000:.2f}W")
    else:
        print("⚠️ Battery data not found (Windows/Linux/MacOS ke hisab se).")

def optimize_power_settings():
    """System ke power settings ko optimize karta hai."""
    print("\n🔄 Optimizing Power Settings...")

    # Windows ke liye (Power Plan adjust karna)
    if os.name == 'nt':
        try:
            subprocess.run(['powercfg', '/setactive', '8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c6354'], shell=True)
            print("   ✅ Windows Power Plan optimized (Balanced mode).")
        except:
            print("   ⚠️ Powercfg command fail ho gayi. Admin rights chahiye.")

    # Linux ke liye (CPU frequency scaling)
    elif os.name == 'posix':
        try:
            with open('/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpufreq/scaling_governor', 'r') as f:
                current_governor = f.read().strip()
            if current_governor != 'powersave':
                subprocess.run(['sudo', 'cpufreq-set', '-g', 'powersave'], shell=True)
                print("   ✅ Linux CPU governor optimized (Powersave mode).")
        except:
            print("   ⚠️ Linux CPU scaling fail ho gayi. Sudo rights chahiye.")

    # MacOS ke liye (Energy Saver)
    else:
        print("   ⚠️ MacOS ke liye manual settings chahiye (System Preferences > Energy Saver).")

def main():
    print("🚀 Battery & CPU Optimizer (Python)")
    print("-------------------------------")

    while True:
        check_battery_health()
        optimize_power_settings()

        # 5 minutes baad auto check karne ke liye
        time.sleep(300)
        print("\n⏳ Next check in 5 minutes...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
